name: Experience
description: XP and leveling system. Characters with a 'level' trait gain XP and level up automatically.
author: Nekon

mc_id.tooltip: Character id of the MC. Their level is snapshotted as the dungeon level on first entry of each level group.

auto_scaling.tooltip: Enables dungeon-level scaling: level snapshots on dungeon entry, dungeon-bound inventory creation, equipment instance scaling, and level-scaled threat. Off = plain XP and leveling only.

shared_level.tooltip: Party-wide progression: a numeric xp action grants the whole party (off = the MC only), and a character joining the party is levelled up to the MC's level and XP, receiving every level-up bonus on the way (requires a level trait).

scale_per_level.tooltip: Reward scaling per dungeon level: effective threat = base threat × (1 + scale_per_level × (dungeon_level − 1)). Also scales equipment stats and ability enhancements.

price_scale_per_level.tooltip: Price growth per level for scaled equipment, independent of the power curve. Empty = twice scale_per_level (gear value climbs faster than its power, so old gear sells for less relative to replacements). Set equal to scale_per_level to weld value to power.

loot_equipment_coef.tooltip: Equipment loot budget = BASE battle threat x this. Not level-scaled: created equipment instances scale their own stats/value to the dungeon level. 0 disables the group.

loot_income_coef.tooltip: Income loot budget = EFFECTIVE battle threat (level-scaled) x this, spent on junk-category items; the remainder pays out as the currency item. 0 disables the group.

loot_max_items.tooltip: Maximum items each loot group can roll per reward.

loot_equipment_categories.tooltip: Item categories the equipment loot group rolls from (and that scale to the dungeon level on creation).

loot_income_categories.tooltip: Item categories the income loot group rolls from (e.g. sellable junk). Empty = the whole income budget pays out as the currency item.

loot_currency_item.tooltip: Currency item paid out from the leftover income budget.

reward_sound_open.tooltip: Sound played when the reward panel appears. Empty = silent.

reward_sound_level_up.tooltip: Sound played on each level-up rollover of the reward panel's XP bar. Empty = silent.

threat_xp_coef.tooltip: XP granted to the party per point of effective threat when a battle is defeated (fight or scripted win). 0 disables defeat XP.

xp_base.tooltip: XP threshold to level up at level 1.

xp_formula.tooltip: How XP threshold scales per level. See the docs for specific formulas.

xp_growth.tooltip: Growth percentage applied per level to the XP threshold.

xp_table.tooltip: Custom XP thresholds per level (index 0 = level 1). Levels beyond the table use the last entry.

level_up_rewards.tooltip: Currency items (e.g., ability points) awarded to the character's private inventory on each level up. Only items with 'is_currency' enabled appear.

item_id.tooltip: Currency item to award (e.g., skill points).

character_stats.name: XP Modifier
character_stats.description: Percent modifier to XP gain. 0 = normal (100%), 20 = +20%, -50 = halved.

character_traits.tooltip: Character's current level. Set in character template to enable XP/leveling.
Status to apply on each level up. Stacks automatically – each level adds one stack. Use for stat growth per level.

dungeon_traits.description: Dungeons sharing this group share one level snapshot, taken on first entry of any of them. Convention: name it after the group's main dungeon id.

item_traits.description: Minimum level for generated drops and shop stock (dungeon level for loot, MC level for trade). Empty = no floor. Authored drop tables and inventories ignore it.
Maximum level for generated drops and shop stock (dungeon level for loot, MC level for trade). Empty = no ceiling. Authored drop tables and inventories ignore it.

inventory_traits.description: Instantiated on first entry of this dungeon (or any dungeon sharing its level group). Items are created and locked there, picking up the dungeon level.
Pool entry drawn into this inventory on top of its authored items when it is instantiated (chance mode, one draw per entity).
Re-roll the pooled stock (authored items are kept) whenever the MC's level has changed since the last roll. For shops; leave off for chests so contents stay locked.
